content.intro: Learn ordering and limiting results through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.
content.why_it_matters: Ordering and Limiting Results matters because a Django project has to behave predictably across requests, database state, configuration, and deployments. Understanding this piece makes the surrounding application easier to test, maintain, and secure.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines ordering and limiting results as part of the django orm and querysets. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.

content_blocks.title: What to cover
